15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is dynamically generated and includes load balancing parameters specific to the requested resource__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is based on real-time analysis of the load balancing parameters and resource availability__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __that is distinct from and separate from any URL encoding of server selection information__, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature __embedded as a separate parameter__ identifying a media request __and distinguishing the media request from standard HTTP requests__.

(Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer; and selecting the first server computer based on the information, __wherein the media request broker performs the selection based on criteria including at least one of: server load, network latency, geographic proximity, or resource availability__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __using a dynamic selection algorithm that evaluates real-time server metrics and adjusts selection criteria based on current network conditions__.
